row: Carlson College of Veterinary Medicine - OSU

The Gary R. Carlson, MD, College of Veterinary Medicine at Oregon State University serves the needs of Oregon, the nation and the world by training the next generation of practice-ready veterinarians, providing state-of-the-art diagnostic and clinical services and supporting the continuing education of veterinary practitioners. Biomedical research conducted at the college increasingly expands the scope of veterinary medicine to address both animal health issues and the relevance of animal diseases to public health.
